name: Frosten: Two Realms
source:
A story about a young man named Ivan, who possesses the unique ability to freeze objects. His life takes a dramatic turn when he finds himself in a mysterious world filled with magic and danger. Alongside friends—both old and new—Ivan must uncover the secrets of his gift and find his way home.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3964450/]Steam[/url]]
